title: Data-Driven and Cycle-Agnostic Covariate Selection for Nonparametric Causal Effect Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2605.06385v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating causal effects from observational data requires identifying valid adjustment sets. This task is especially challenging in realistic settings where latent confounding and feedback loops are present. Existing approaches typically assume acyclicity or rely on global causal structure learning, limiting applicability and computational efficiency. In this work, we study a local, data-driven method for covariate selection based on conditional independence information under a pre-treatment assumption. While this method is known to be sound and complete in acyclic causal models, its validity in the presence of cycles has remained unclear. Our main contribution is to show that these guarantees extend to cyclic causal models. In particular, our result relies on the invariance of conditional independence assertions under $\sigma$-acyclification. translated_title: 面向非参数因果效应估计的数据驱动且与环路无关的协变量选择方法
translated_abstract: 从观测数据中估计因果效应需要识别有效的调整集。在存在潜在混杂因素和反馈环路的现实场景中，这一任务尤为困难。现有方法通常假设因果结构无环，或依赖全局因果结构学习，从而限制了其适用性和计算效率。在本工作中，我们研究了一种局部的、数据驱动的协变量选择方法，该方法在预处理假设下基于条件独立性信息进行协变量选择。虽然已知该方法在无环因果模型中是可靠且完备的，但其在存在环路情形下的有效性一直不明确。我们的主要贡献是证明了这些理论保证可以扩展到含环路的因果模型。特别地，我们的结果依赖于条件独立性断言在σ-去环化（σ-acyclification）下的不变性。这些发现为协变量选择建立了一个统一的、与环路无关的视角。
tldr: 该论文证明基于条件独立性的局部数据驱动协变量选择方法的有效性保证可从无环因果模型扩展到含环因果模型，从而为非参数因果效应估计建立了统一的、与环路无关的协变量选择框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the soundness and completeness guarantees of a local, data-driven covariate selection method based on conditional independence extend from acyclic causal models to cyclic causal models, establishing a unified, cycle-agnostic framework for covariate selection in nonparametric causal effect estimation.
